pure_diagnostic_rule: pure bool alone cannot qualify exact diagnostic; retain raw stderr and check actual feature, subject, safe offset0/memory indication for each negative; unavailable log wiring, unrelated error/crash not PASS
compiler_diagnostic_rule: require caught parse invalid plus feature_required with independent fixture-specified feature and subject; all unrelated exceptions rethrow
